name: io.github.christianclaudio/mcp-server-kalshi
description: Kalshi MCP fork. Install via git or GHCR; not published to PyPI or the registry.

environmentVariables.name: KALSHI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Kalshi API key ID; required only for portfolio/order tools

environmentVariables.name: KALSHI_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to your RSA private key .pem; required for authenticated tools

environmentVariables.name: BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional explicit REST base override (must include /trade-api/v2)

environmentVariables.name: KALSHI_READONLY
environmentVariables.description: When true (1), restricts server exclusively to read-only tools
